title: llm-kit comparison case, version 1 (one line of a case file)
description: One line of a comparison case file (JSON Lines, UTF-8): the case id and the text value of each prompt slot. Reader rules the subset cannot state: a final LF is allowed and an empty line elsewhere is refused; a CR before the LF is removed; the ids of one file are unique; a case names exactly the slots of the prompt it is used with (checked against that prompt). Written in llm-scripting-kit.json-schema-subset/v1. Contract and shared cases: docs/reference/llm-kit-formats.md.

id.description: The case id: non-empty text, unique in the file.

slots.description: Slot name -> the text that fills it.
